title: how to add custom field customers to print builder

posts.cooked: hello i add 4 custom field (nif nis ai rib) and when i try to add it in print builder invoice not showing what to do ?

posts.name: Priytesh
posts.cooked:
@blackhost Please make sure your custom fields do not have “Print Hide” checked. Otherwise, they won’t appear in the Print Builder list. After saving custom fields, refresh / clear cache (Ctrl+Shift+R or bench clear-cache + bench build) so that Print Builder picks them up. If still not visible: In Print Builder, click Add Field → Custom Field → search for your field name (e.g., nif). If it doesn’t show, you may need to manually add it via Custom Print Format (Jinja) eg,

NIF: {{ doc.nif }}
